children.value: > Fact From Story Republicans dropped Rep. Jim Jordan on Friday as their nominee for House speaker, making the decision during a closed-door session after the hard-edged ally of Donald Trump failed badly on a third ballot for the gavel.

> > Fact From Story In a floor vote Friday morning, Jordan’s third reach for the gavel, he lost 25 Republican colleagues, worse than he had fared earlier in the week, and far from the majority needed, as they reject his hardline approach.
> > > Fact From Story The hard-charging Judiciary Committee chairman said House Republicans now need to come together and “figure out who our speaker is going to be.”
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A person dropping out of a race indicates that they know they will not win.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Losing support in each vote indicates a lack of viability.
> Commonsense Knowledge If someone fails badly multiple times, they are likely to be dropped.
